name: LTX-2.3 + Krea 2 General Continuation Loop — Local GGUF JSON
description: A reusable general-purpose continuation loop built from SineForge's LTX workflow and the library's existing Krea 2 image-generation settings. Scene or subject and next event are the primary controls; dialogue is optional JSON rather than a podcast-shaped form. Each cycle uses selectable local-GGUF JSON planning, creates and saves a fresh 16-bit Krea anchor, and uses a separate Ingredients/reference image as planner context, Krea image conditioning, and an LTX reference-conditioned Ingredients IC-LoRA model override. It animates the saved anchor with LTX-2.3, stores an FFV1 + FLAC master, extracts the true final tensor frame, saves it as 16-bit PNG, and passes the unchanged tensor into the next cycle. Loop counts 1+ are exact; 0 keeps running until ComfyUI Interrupt.
instructions:
1. Load any starting image in node 1.
2. Load a clean Ingredients/reference sheet in node 1B. This can be a character sheet, product sheet, studio/set sheet, or style sheet. Do not include labels or clutter if you want identity/reference conditioning to work well.
3. Set node 2 `loop_count`. Values 1 through 100000 run exactly that many cycles. Set 0 for continuous mode; internally it resolves to 100000 cycles, so stop it at any time with ComfyUI Interrupt. Start with 1 while tuning.
4. In node 3, describe any `scene_or_subject` and the `next_event`. These are the primary controls. The workflow does not assume a podcast, conversation, people, or any particular genre.
5. Choose node 3 `audio_mode`: `automatic from scene`, `no dialogue`, `dialogue JSON`, or `advanced JSON only`.
6. Dialogue is optional and JSON-only. Leave `dialogue_json` as `[]` unless `audio_mode` is `dialogue JSON`. For exact speech, use an ordered array such as `[{"speaker":"Character A","position":"camera-left","line":"Exact words"},{"speaker":"Character B","position":"camera-right","line":"Exact reply"}]`. Optional per-turn keys are `delivery` and `action`.
7. Keep node 3 `recent_cycles_json` as `[]` unless you paste valid JSON history. The advanced `continuation_request_json` remains available for full-contract edits.
8. Node 3 offers every local executable GGUF package beneath the LM Studio model root; Qwen 3.6 40B is only the default. Vision-capable models receive the current frame and node 1B reference image. Text-only models remain usable and receive the JSON scene request without image attachments. Every selected model is fully unloaded before Krea/LTX generation.
9. Node 8 uses `Krea2EncodeRebalance`; `image1` is the current loop frame and `image2` is the Ingredients/reference sheet. This makes Krea anchor generation reference-aware instead of text-only.
10. Nodes 27–31 load the LTX model, apply the official Ingredients IC-LoRA, enable LTX reference-token injection, attach node 1B as the reference image, and feed the patched model into node 15 through `model_override`.
11. Node 14 saves the new Krea image as a 16-bit PNG and returns the same unmodified tensor. LTX is connected to that Save node's output, making successful anchor creation the hard dependency for video generation.
12. Node 16 saves the generated frame batch and native audio as FFV1 + FLAC in MKV. No H.264 intermediate is used.
13. Node 18 selects the final generated tensor frame with `batch_index=-1`. Node 20 saves a 16-bit PNG and returns the same tensor to node 22 for the next cycle.
14. Node 17 saves the full request, generated prompts, seeds, source-image hash, reference-image hash, and planner result as `.json`.
15. If a cycle fails, earlier PNG, FFV1, and JSON outputs remain recoverable. Set node 2 to 1 while tuning.
16. “Lossless” applies to handoff and storage. Krea and LTX are generative models, so newly synthesized content cannot be mathematically pixel-identical or lossless.

requirements.documentation_notes: The Krea model, Krea text encoder, Krea VAE, LTX checkpoint, LTX encoders, LTX VAEs, LTX upscaler, and official Ingredients IC-LoRA are exact physical files under `C:\ComfyUI\ComfyUI_Shared_Folders\models`. Node 8 uses Krea2EncodeRebalance with the current frame and reference sheet. Nodes 27-31 produce the reference-conditioned LTX model_override. SaveImageAdvanced uses 16-bit PNG and returns the original tensor. VHS saves FFV1 video with FLAC audio. ImageFromBatch selects the true last frame before encoding. All prompt artifacts are JSON.

widgets_values:
# SineForge · Krea 2 + LTX-2.3 Lossless Continuation Loop

1. Load any starting image.
2. Load an Ingredients/reference sheet in node 1B. Use a clean panel sheet for recurring characters, wardrobe, props, style, or studio/set identity.
3. Set `loop_count` on node 2. Values 1+ run exactly that many cycles. Set 0 to keep going until you press ComfyUI Interrupt.
4. On node 3, describe any `scene_or_subject` and the `next_event`. The defaults make no assumption about people, podcasts, or dialogue.
5. Choose `audio_mode`: automatic from scene, no dialogue, dialogue JSON, or advanced JSON only. `dialogue_json` is optional and defaults to `[]`.
6. For exact speech, choose dialogue JSON and use entries such as `[{"speaker":"Character A","position":"camera-left","line":"Exact words"}]`.
7. Keep `recent_cycles_json` as `[]` unless you paste valid JSON history. The advanced `continuation_request_json` remains available for full-contract control.
8. Node 3 lists every local executable GGUF package. Qwen 3.6 40B is the default only. Vision models see both images; text-only models receive the JSON scene request without image attachments. Krea still uses both images through `Krea2EncodeRebalance`.
9. The LTX model path uses the official Ingredients IC-LoRA plus LTX reference-token conditioning, then feeds the patched model into the Sulphur all-in-one node via `model_override`.
10. The Krea sampler creates a fresh 768×448 anchor. Node 14 saves it as 16-bit PNG and passes the same unmodified tensor into LTX.
11. LTX produces native audio/video. Node 16 saves a lossless FFV1 + FLAC master.
12. Node 18 extracts the true final tensor frame before encoding. Node 20 saves it as 16-bit PNG and passes the same tensor into the next cycle.
13. Every planner artifact and all editable dialogue are JSON. No hosted/API agent is used.

**Lossless scope:** PNG/FFV1/FLAC storage and in-memory handoffs avoid additional codec loss. Krea and LTX generation themselves are generative and cannot be mathematically lossless.
